alternatives_and_negative_results: Do not label a duplicate implementation or same-helper comparison as independent oracle evidence.
applicability: RTL verification using frozen C03-C05 oracle implementations and separately authored golden vectors.
assessed_root_cause: Shared code and shared intermediate assumptions create common-mode error that ordinary regression tests cannot detect.
author_role: historical project engineering record, backfilled by FPGA engineering copilot
chosen_corrective_method: Use independent arithmetic derivation and a structurally different grouping algorithm; compare exact intermediate and final records.
generalizable_lesson: Independence should be demonstrated by source/data-flow separation and algorithmic diversity, not by module naming.
initial_faulty_assumption_or_design_deci: Calling the same helper twice, or comparing two outputs derived from one implementation path, could be described as independent verification.
non_applicability: Does not prove independence from every shared upstream model assumption; test assumptions and input truth separately.
observable_consequence: C03 uses rational Fraction-based arithmetic and independently derived constants; C05 uses union-find connected components to cross-check the native BFS grouping.
observed_problem: A self-check can agree with a DUT while sharing its arithmetic or algorithmic defect.
repeatable_validation: Run directed primitive vectors, full-chain vectors and exact grouping/record comparisons; confirm zero mismatches in the accepted C03-C05 evidence.
reviewer_role: documentary evidence validation by FPGA engineering copilot; not a separate human reviewer
safety_contract_constraints: Do not edit or merge oracle code with RTL/DUT arithmetic; preserve source hashes and independent ownership.
title: Independence requires a different computational path, not a second call to the DUT helper
